manifest.instructions: Inspect only the selected Python function. Call search_repository and read_file with the supplied arguments in one batch if possible. In the docstring describe the behavior of an unset variable, an explicitly empty string, and every recognized literal. Copy the original selected function exactly. Preserve unrelated behavior.
